findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：通膨與關稅曾使公司成本上升，且可能無法在固定價格、單價與 GMP 合約中完全回收；法規與關稅變動會影響材料或設備價格。2025 年國際營收 $489.7M（9%）。
findings.excerpt: Economic factors, including inflation and tariffs, have also previously subjected us, and could in the future subject us, to higher costs, which we may not be able to fully recover in future projects that we are bidding

findings.claim: 10-K MD&A：公司表示預期關稅不會造成重大衝擊，採事前（估價含成本上升、談判價格調整條款）與事後（鋼材、混凝土、大型設備提早買斷、固定價格分包）策略轉嫁風險。
findings.excerpt: Once the project is awarded, the Company’s strategy shifts to entering into purchase orders or “buy-outs” of materials, such as steel and concrete, as well as large pieces of equipment at the onset of projects, which mitigate the risk of future equipment and commodity price increases by passing that risk to vendors.
